source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The complete D237517 review proposes connect-src * to preserve localhost provider-test pings. The author rejects broadening the policy only for a test; the reviewer requests an explanation, and the later expert reply has no test-only solution and qualifies the concern because privileged channel APIs bypass connect-src. Preserve those distinct positions. The inspected fixed cached CalDAV helper waits for mPendingSync; ICS waits for queue/lock state, while uncached CalDAV has an empty helper. Existing lesson30add962ce0e59e68027b0016c38dd883a67bcbc028733520aae934779f7bfa3 owns those source facts. This review adds their bounded decision history; it does not establish a universal ban or allowance for test connections, or prove an empty helper waits for idle. No policy/provider test ran.
title: D237517 did not settle a general policy for test-only connections
